title: From Cosmetic to Structural: A Paired Experiment on Metric-Guided Agentic Refactoring
abstract: arXiv:2610.33343v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: The role of coding agents is expanding beyond writing new code toward maintaining existing systems as AI teammates. Yet recent studies show that agent refactorings favor superficial, consistency-oriented edits over structural transformations needed to resolve Technical Debt (TD). We investigate if explicit static-analysis feedback closes this gap. Through the CodeScene MCP server, we give an open-source agent (gptme) access to code smell reports and CodeHealth (CH) scores (1--10, higher is better), and compare guided against unguided refactorings in a paired experiment covering $24{,}620$ single-file competitive programming solutions in C++, Java, and Python. We find that guidance shifts the agent from performing cosmetic edits toward structural operations, raising the rate of effective refactorings by $21$--$26$ percentage points. The benefit depends on initial code quality, with language-dependent break-even points at CH $4.9$--$7.1$,

translated_title: 从表面修饰到结构重构：一项关于指标引导下智能体重构的配对实验
translated_abstract: 编码智能体的角色正在从编写新代码扩展到作为AI队友维护现有系统。然而，近期研究表明，智能体的重构倾向于表面化、一致性导向的编辑，而非解决技术债（TD）所需的结构性转换。我们研究了显式的静态分析反馈能否弥合这一差距。通过CodeScene MCP服务器，我们让开源智能体gptme能够访问代码坏味报告和代码健康度（CH）评分（1-10分，分数越高越好），并在一项涵盖24,620个C++、Java和Python单文件竞赛编程解决方案的配对实验中，比较了有引导与无引导的重构效果。我们发现，引导使智能体从执行表面修饰性编辑转向结构性操作，将有效重构率提高了21至26个百分点。其收益取决于初始代码质量，各语言存在不同的盈亏平衡点，位于CH 4.9至7.1之间。
tldr: 显式静态分析反馈能够引导编码智能体从表面修饰性编辑转向结构性重构，将有效重构率提升21至26个百分点，且其收益取决于初始代码质量，各语言的盈亏平衡点位于CH 4.9至7.1之间。
en_tdlr: Explicit static-analysis feedback guides coding agents from cosmetic edits toward structural refactoring, raising effective refactoring rates by 21-26 percentage points, with benefits depending on initial code quality and language-dependent break-even points at CH 4.9-7.1.
